name: Positive-Overlap Rooted Factor of Order 621
definition: Recover the 621-concept block $K$ from the certified 909-concept cut-vertex obstruction as in the positive-overlap rooted-factor theorem, and mark its degree-two corner root $r$.
parameters: $|K|=621$ and dimension 25; its canonical sections have orders 331, 149, and 140, with overlaps of orders 3 and 65.
properties: $(K,r)$ is a rooted factor. All three sections and both overlaps peel to zero, but one side does not peel relatively to its three-concept overlap. It is the concrete witness that positive overlaps survive rooted minimization and that the four-relative-order construction is not exhaustive.
